Same semi-realistic comic illustration style with clean ink outlines as the attached reference. Plain pure white background, no text, no character.

The exact same image as the reference: same character, same face, same camera angle, same scale, same position on the canvas, same feet position, same outfit, same comic style, plain pure white background. The ONLY change: he places one hand flat on the left side of his chest over his heart, and a soft red glow shines from his chest under his hand, serious caring face.

The character in the image is H: keep him EXACTLY the same (bald, white letter H on the forehead, big muscular body, black shorts, olive tactical belt with pouches, black wrist wraps), same semi-realistic comic illustration style with detailed shading, NOT flat or 2D. Vertical 9:16 YouTube Shorts cover, 1080x1920, very sharp. ONE plain flat dark red background #7A1A1A with a soft teal #0F8B85 glow behind H.
